A '''glow-cutter''' was a type of weapon. [[Bwahl]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] contracted [[Celia Durasha]] and [[Kaj Nedmak]] to transport a shipment of weapons, including glow-cutters, to [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]].<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Crimson Bounty}}</ref>
